<p align="center">I build products end to end, from the first design frame to the store release, and increasingly the AI that runs inside them.</p>
<p align="center">Software Engineering at <b>ESPRIT</b> after a Bachelor's from <b>ISIG Kairouan</b>. Two apps of my own live on iOS and Android, built alone across mobile, backend, cloud and design. Currently in Germany. Arabic, French, English.</p>

<p align="center"><b>Click straight on a board.</b> GitHub opens your move as a ready-made issue: press <b>Create</b> and my bot answers in about ten seconds, then the board here redraws itself. Every game counts on the scoreboard.</p>
